etsy.title: Kindness Bunny Kit, Easter Countdown for Kids, Bunny Letter and 14 Kindness Notes, Easter Egg Hunt Clues, Candy Free Easter Activity
etsy.description:
Kindness instead of more candy. 🐰

A little bunny hops in with one kind mission a day for the 14 days before Easter. Read it together, do it together, color an egg on the tracker. Five minutes a day, no mess.

WHAT'S INSIDE (18 pages)
• Bunny arrival letter
• Bunny passport
• 14 kindness notes (4 per page)
• Egg tracker
• 2 lifesaver letters
• Halfway letter
• 4 egg hunt clue cards
• Easter goodbye letter + "I Was Kind!" certificate
• 8 blank notes + 30 tiny kindness ideas

AGES: 3 to 8.

PAIR IT WITH: Kindness Leprechaun (March) and Kindness Cupid (February) in our shop.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
